ayahs.1: By the winds that scatter dust—Allah swears by forces that spread His decree across the earth.
ayahs.2: And by the clouds heavy with rain,
ayahs.3: and by the ships that glide with ease,
ayahs.4: and by the angels who distribute every affair by His command—
ayahs.5: what you are promised is certainly true.
ayahs.6: And the Day of Judgment will certainly come to pass.
ayahs.7: By the heaven with its marvellous design—
ayahs.8: you are lost in conflicting opinions about the truth.
ayahs.9: Only those already destined to stray are turned away from it.
ayahs.11: those steeped in ignorance, completely heedless.
ayahs.12: They ask mockingly: When is this Day of Judgment?
ayahs.13: The Day they will be tormented over the Fire.
ayahs.14: Taste your torment. This is what you kept rushing to bring upon yourselves.
ayahs.15: The people of taqwa will be amid Gardens and springs,
ayahs.16: joyfully receiving what their Rabb gives them. Before this reward they were already doers of good:
ayahs.17: they slept little in the night,
ayahs.18: and before dawn they asked Allah for forgiveness,
ayahs.19: and in their wealth there was a due share for the beggar and the deprived.
ayahs.20: On earth are ayahs for those with certain iman,
ayahs.21: and within yourselves as well. Will you not see?
ayahs.22: In heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
ayahs.23: Then by the Rabb of heaven and earth—this is as true as the fact that you can speak.
ayahs.24: Has the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached you?
ayahs.25: When they entered his presence and said 'Peace,' he replied, 'Peace,' and thought to himself: These are unfamiliar people.
ayahs.26: He went quietly to his family and brought a fat roasted calf,
ayahs.27: and set it before them, saying: Will you not eat?
ayahs.28: When they did not eat, he grew uneasy about them. They said: Do not fear—and gave him glad news of a knowledgeable son.
ayahs.29: His wife came forward with a cry, striking her face in astonishment: A child from a barren old woman?
ayahs.30: They said: Such is what your Rabb has decreed. He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.
ayahs.31: Abraham asked: What is your mission, O messengers?
ayahs.32: They said: We have been sent to a wicked people,
ayahs.33: to rain upon them stones of baked clay,
ayahs.34: marked by your Rabb for those who crossed every limit.
ayahs.35: We brought out the believers who were in that city before the punishment.
ayahs.36: But We found in it only one household that had submitted.
ayahs.37: We left a sign there for those who fear the painful punishment.
ayahs.38: And in Moses—when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority,
ayahs.39: Pharaoh turned away with his armies and said: He is a magician or a madman.
ayahs.40: So We seized him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea. He was blameworthy.
ayahs.41: And in 'Ad—when We sent against them the devastating wind,
ayahs.42: which left nothing it touched except shattered ruins.
ayahs.43: And in Thamud—when they were told: Enjoy yourselves for a little while.
ayahs.44: They defied their Rabb's command, so the blast seized them while they watched.
ayahs.45: They could not stand up, and no one helped them.
ayahs.46: And the people of Noah before them—they were a rebellious people.
ayahs.47: We built the universe with power, and We are expanding it.
ayahs.48: We spread out the earth—how excellent a spreader We are.
ayahs.49: And of everything We created pairs, so perhaps you would take heed.
ayahs.50: Say: Flee to Allah. I am sent to you from Him with a clear warning.
ayahs.51: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am sent to you from Him with a clear warning.
ayahs.52: Every messenger who came to those before them was met with: A magician or a madman!
ayahs.53: Have they handed this cliché down to one another? In truth, they are a people who transgressed every limit.
ayahs.54: So turn away from them, O Prophet—you are not to blame.
ayahs.55: But keep reminding, for reminding benefits the mu'min.
ayahs.56: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me.
ayahs.57: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.
ayahs.58: Allah is the Provider, the Lord of power, the Almighty.
ayahs.59: The wrongdoers will have a share of torment like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten it.
ayahs.60: Woe to those who reject the truth when they face the Day they were warned about.
